source_evidence: Exact player 'Let see if our steward at silverward knows an mine inspector' authorizes returning to Silverward and asking Hessa Marr about a mining specialist. D338~07:08–07:40 V/Cirren/Fenar retrace secured rope routes to surface, Cirren renews Light cantrip on shield as needed (no slot), leaves borrowed site rope safely deployed and bracing intact; reunite with Mara and healthy coach/four horses. No ore samples, coins, notes, equipment or other abandoned property claimed by V; original Galepierce already recovered. Depart ~07:45 on established remaining six rough miles of D335–338 western tower-to-Silverward reverse route (1.5mi/h, 4h), arrival Silverward ~11:45 same day, completes leg30/30mi. Day337 random encounter already filled leg cap1/1; no extra random occurrence roll on remaining leg, no new established threat. Allocate D338 full travel-day rations3/feed4 once at arrival, stock24→21/32→28. No toll, purchase, rest or limited-feature use. Hessa present and consulted ~11:50. DM establishes grounded ordinary new local contact via her longstanding ferry traffic and local crafts/supplier network: Hessa has previously dealt with a traveling mining surveyor through stone and ore merchants, knows how to contact him through those merchants; he has experience in assessing old workings and arranging ore assays. Name, exact residence, present availability, fees, travel time, willingness and credentials not yet verified. She agrees under existing stewardship mandate to make discreet inquiries for a site assessment, assay, structural/flood safety and likely extraction costs, obtaining a quote before any engagement or expense, and to keep the suspected silver-bearing site confidential except necessary arrangements. No actual hire, fee, payment, message receipt, inspection, title claim, estimate, production or asset value. No new named NPC introduced; role/contact only. No uncertain skill or encounter roll warranted for ordinary firsthand acquaintance; no assumed response to future inquiry. Hessa's existing workday/payroll/other restoration planning remains unreconciled, no results fabricated or erased. Party at Silverward; Hessa awaits actual follow-through and V may give further instructions. Other existing estate/ancestry/quest/custody unchanged.
